organizations.role_ru: Issues the documents and passes the salary data. The whole chain starts with them.
A separate agency under the Ministry of Labor. Registers you as a job seeker and keeps the reporting record. It pays no money, but without it there will be no payments.
Since 2023 you no longer file documents in two places separately: one online form on the MyGov portal goes at once to the Employment Service and to Bituach Leumi.
An independent state institution. Examines the claim and pays the money. It receives the reporting data from the Employment Service.

forms.name_ru: Registration with the Employment Service + benefit claim in one action
forms.note_ru: In operation since August 2023. One form on the MyGov portal via the national identification system — the data automatically goes to the Employment Service and to Bituach Leumi. The filing date counts both as the registration date with the Service and as the start date of benefit entitlement. Condition: report to the office within 15 days of filing.
The main document. Filed online in the personal account. A single 1514 certificate cannot be sent instead — the claim itself must be filled in.

This is NOT a form you are given in hand. Since October 2021 all employers must transmit data for every employee electronically each month, by the 15th. For the benefit, it matters that the transfer states the date and reason the work ended. Bituach Leumi writes plainly: “your employer must transmit form 100; you only need to make sure they did.” There is also a printed annual version of form 100 — you may request it from the employer covering the last 7 years, but it is needed to reconcile insurance contributions, not for the benefit.

forms.name_ru: Employer's certificate of the work period and salary
forms.who_ru: filled in and signed by the employer
forms.note_ru: Needed only if the employer did NOT transmit form 100. These are pages 5–6 inside form 1500, but the form also exists separately.

forms.name_ru: The same as the work-period certificate — usually one document
forms.note_ru: Must contain: the reason the work ended (dismissal, voluntary resignation, Halat, pension), the exact end date, the start and end dates of the employment, a signature and a stamp. The employer must issue it within 14 days, or 7 days upon a written request.

forms.name_ru: Notice of leaving work (not for the benefit)
forms.who_ru: filled in by the employer, part B by the employee
forms.to_ru: Tax Authority, a copy for you
forms.note_ru: It has nothing to do with the benefit — it concerns severance compensation. But take it right away, while contact with the employer is still fresh.

forms.name_ru: Pay slips (tlushim) for the last 18 months
forms.to_ru: Bituach Leumi, if there is no form 100
forms.note_ru: The pay slip for the last month of work is mandatory. The slips must show the number of working days.
Without registration with the Service the claim will be rejected — this is written plainly on form 1500.

forms.name_ru: Teudat shihrur, or national-service completion certificate
forms.note_ru: Needed by those demobilised within the last year and a half: it gives preferential record conditions.

journey.title_ru: You have received a dismissal notice
journey.what_ru: First of all, gather the documents while you are still formally an employee — it is faster and easier. The list of what to ask for is right below this block.
journey.warn_ru: The one thing to be careful about: do not sign a waiver of claims in exchange for the settlement. The law does not require it, and the signature may cost you part of the money.

journey.title_ru: Collect the documents from the employer
journey.when_ru: immediately and within the next 14 days
journey.what_ru: Termination letter with the reason and date, work-period certificate, form 161, the last pay slip, the final settlement.
journey.warn_ru: Send the request in writing — then the certificate deadline shrinks from 14 days to 7.

journey.what_ru: One question to the bookkeeper: did they transmit to Bituach Leumi the salary data with the date and reason the work ended? If yes — no pay slips need to be attached. If no — ask them to fill in certificate BL/1514.
journey.warn_ru: This is the most common reason a claim hangs for weeks.

journey.when_ru: within 7 days after the work ends
journey.what_ru: One form on the MyGov portal registers you with the Employment Service and at the same time files the benefit claim with Bituach Leumi. The filing date becomes both the registration date and the start date of benefit entitlement.
journey.warn_ru: After filing you must report to the office within 15 days — set a reminder.

journey.title_ru: Report to the office and keep reporting
journey.when_ru: within 15 days after filing, then on schedule
journey.what_ru: The Service monthly passes to Bituach Leumi the number of days you reported. The money is calculated from this report.
journey.warn_ru: For a missed report the payment is not calculated, so keep the schedule at hand. You may not refuse suitable work offered by the office — that also affects payments.

journey.title_ru: Wait for the decision and the payment
journey.when_ru: decision in 30–45 days, money another 10–15 days
journey.what_ru: A notice will arrive with the daily amount and the number of days. After that, payments are monthly according to your reports. Watch the personal account: if something is missing, a request will appear there.
journey.warn_ru: If refused, you have the right to appeal. Often a refusal is lifted by sending the missing documents.

parallel_rights.note_ru: Usually one month's salary for each year of work. Arranged via form 161, not via Bituach Leumi.

parallel_rights.name_ru: Release of savings in the pension fund
parallel_rights.note_ru: The employer must notify the fund within 15 days that they make no claim to this money.
Included in the final settlement if not yet paid.
Mandatory to pay in the settlement.
If your avtala days have ended or the benefit is not due. A separate application to Bituach Leumi.

employer_checklist.item_ru: Termination letter with all the details
employer_checklist.he: מכתב פיטורים / אישור על תקופת העבודה
employer_checklist.why_ru: Usually this is one document. It must contain: the reason the work ended, the exact end date, the start and end dates of the employment, a signature and a stamp. The employer must issue it by law — whether you were dismissed or resigned yourself.
employer_checklist.deadline_ru: 14 days from the last working day, or 7 days upon a written request

employer_checklist.why_ru: Ask the bookkeeper directly: did they transmit the salary data with the date and reason the work ended? This is the main reason claims hang.
employer_checklist.deadline_ru: clarify immediately; it is transmitted by the 15th of the month

employer_checklist.item_ru: Certificate BL/1514 — if form 100 was not transmitted
employer_checklist.why_ru: The fallback: the employer fills in and signs a certificate of the work period and salary.
employer_checklist.deadline_ru: only if there is no form 100

employer_checklist.item_ru: Form 161 (not for the benefit, but take it)
employer_checklist.why_ru: It has nothing to do with avtala — it concerns severance compensation and the tax on it. But get it at the same time, while you are in contact with the employer: without it, withdrawing the compensation is taxed at a higher rate.
employer_checklist.deadline_ru: the employer must issue it, by the 15th of the following month

employer_checklist.why_ru: Mandatory if the data is submitted manually. The slip must show the number of working days.
Severance compensation, unused vacation, recuperation pay. Check that everything has been accrued.
employer_checklist.deadline_ru: on the last day of work or with the nearest salary

employer_checklist.item_ru: Notice to the pension fund releasing the savings
employer_checklist.why_ru: The employer must tell the fund that they make no claim to the compensation money; otherwise you cannot use it.
employer_checklist.deadline_ru: 15 days from the date the work ended

data_policy.summary_ru: All data is taken from officially published state sources and open APIs. Requests are rare, honestly identified, and robots.txt is respected.
principles_ru: Only public pages and open APIs are used, without authorisation or bypassing protections
The bot honestly identifies itself in the User-Agent and states a contact
Frequency — from once a day to once a week; the load is negligible
No personal data is collected at all
Every source is indicated on the page with a link to the original
sources_licensing_ru: data.gov.il — the state open-data portal, published for free use
api.cbs.gov.il — the open API of the Central Bureau of Statistics
ArcGIS FeatureServer of the Ministry of Construction — a public REST service with open CORS
btl.gov.il — public information pages; robots.txt closes only the service sections
Kol-Zchut — materials under a Creative Commons licence; the source is credited when used
not_done_ru: No captcha, authorisation or paid restrictions are bypassed
Databases are not dumped wholesale and no noticeable load is created
Other sites' texts are not copied — only numerical indicators (facts) are taken
